verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack covers API versioning or a deprecation policy for GitLab. The items are about security scanning, platform marketing, community sentiment, an official CLI, and an OpenAPI probe that returned 404, none of which shows versioned APIs or deprecation terms. The axis plainly applies to a DevOps platform, so the absence of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
